decisions.reason: We would keep A because it remains close to our core finishing portfolio and, after already backing it for two years, its modest performance can still be justified as part of a normal market build-up rather than a reason to exit.

We would keep B because, although it is farther from our traditional offer, we launched it very publicly as a flagship and that visible commitment makes withdrawal harder to justify even if results are mixed.
We would keep C because it directly supports our modular automation direction and continued investment in it is easier to defend than admitting an early retreat from a well-aligned extension.
We would keep D because it is both tightly linked to our established business and publicly presented as a strategic B2 flagship, creating the strongest commitment to continue.
We would keep F because it complements existing equipment, has a demonstrated customer application, and the resources already committed favor continuation over withdrawal.
